newsitem.title: USA: S. Calif. home sales up more than 15 pct - report.
newsitem.headline: S. Calif. home sales up more than 15 pct - report.

text.p: Southern California home sales increased by more than 15 percent in the first 10 months of this year compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report released on Tuesday.
Experian said in the report that between January and October of this year, 170,911 escrows closed on single family residence and condominium transactions, versus 147,884 in the same period of 1995.

"Low interest rates and a strengthening regional economy have provided a much needed impetus to the housing market in southern California and in particular to the lower priced sector," said Nima Nattagh, Experian's market analyst.
Experian's figures are based on information collected from county recorders.
